text: Bitcoin is down 3% while Ethereum has fallen 5.7%, signaling weaker conviction in altcoins relative to the largest asset. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral (53) with a 7-day decline, suggesting cautious sentiment without panic, though Bitcoin's 60% dominance indicates some flight to safety. Volume remains robust at $51.6 trillion, confirming the selloff reflects genuine market activity rather than low liquidity.
